fusions.name: Hobbling Loop
fusions.desc: You kick a loop of chain at the first enemy in line, dealing 12 damage, stunning it for 1 second and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Trailing Lash
fusions.desc: You kick out the chain trailing from your harness at a target up to 4 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Anything struck moves 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Lean Into the Traces
fusions.desc: For 6 seconds, a 5-tile collapse ahead of you drags every enemy near it inward.

fusions.name: Link by Link
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict an enemy, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
